matches.rationale: No finding addresses the Equation 2 regression objective's undefined conditioning variable c, the L_reg notation inconsistency, or the mismatch with the L1/L2/Huber losses described in Section 3.3; none of the 12 findings mention this equation or its symbols at all.

Finding 5 directly identifies the contradiction between the claim that all 28 layers exceed L_k>0.7 and the figure/caption stating 15 of 28 layers exceed 0.5, which is exactly the locality-metric inconsistency described in GT2 (R2 polarity reversal aside, same locus and same numbers).

Finding 2 pinpoints the exact corrupted formula in H.1 (softmax attention given as 2L²D+HL² with a spurious 'optimized kernel halves FLOPs' justification) and refutes it against H.2, matching GT3's core defect precisely.
